items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: performing and recording with Red Norvo

ctx.x: Pianist and accordionist Pete Jolly was born in New Haven, Connecticut on June 5, 1932. He found steady work on the west coast, performing and recording with Red Norvo, Chet Baker, Buddy DeFranco and many others. He has led his own trios over the years and had a commercial hit with “Little Bird,” his own composition. Pete has spent a good deal of time in the film and television studios and is well known as one of the top call musicians in the L.A.
